fromNis2.title: Already in from your NIS 2 walkthrough
fromNis2.note: A head start, not a sign-off: this item is approved on its own.

activities.count: {count, plural, =0 {No activity on your record yet} one {# activity on your record} other {# activities on your record}}
activities.suggested: Ticked because your list from the NIS 2 walkthrough has a matching entry
activities.own: Add an activity of your own
activities.recorded: On your record of processing activities

describe.empty: Your record has no activity yet. Choose your activities on the steps before.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.hint: What you process the data for, in one sentence.

legalBases.label: Lawful basis
legalBases.hint: Tick every basis this activity rests on (Art. 6(1)). The ones usually used for this kind of activity are marked; check them against what you actually do.

bases.contract: A contract with the person, or steps before one (b)
bases.public_task: A task in the public interest or official authority (e)

legitimateInterests.label: Which interest, and why it weighs more
legitimateInterests.hint: Name the interest and why the interests of the people concerned do not override it (Art. 6(1)(f)). Example: keeping the network safe from attacks (Recital 49).

dataSubjects.label: People concerned
dataSubjects.hint: Whose data, as groups: for example staff, customers, applicants.

dataCategories.label: Categories of data
dataCategories.hint: Which data, as groups: for example contact details, bank details, contract data.

specialCategories.label: Specially protected data
specialCategories.hint: For example health, religion, trade union membership or biometric data (Art. 9 GDPR), or data on criminal convictions and offences (Art. 10).

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.hint: Who receives the data, inside the company and outside: for example the tax adviser, a payroll service, the tax office.

transfersOutsideEea.label: Outside the EEA
transfersOutsideEea.hint: Does the data go to a country outside the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway?
transfersOutsideEea.details: Where to, and on which basis
transfersOutsideEea.detailsHint: For example: USA, standard contractual clauses

retention.label: Time limit for erasure
retention.hint: When the data is erased, where it is possible to say.

processors.empty: Your supplier list is empty. Enter your service providers on the suppliers page.
processors.noProcessors: None of your suppliers processes data on your behalf. There is nothing to do here.
processors.onlyProcessors: These are the suppliers that process data on your behalf.

role.separate_controller: Processes data for its own purposes
role.joint_controller: Decides purposes and means together with us

contract.yes: A data processing agreement is in place

transfer.no: The data stays in the EEA
transfer.yes: The data also goes to a country outside the EEA

mechanisms.adequacy: Adequacy decision of the European Commission

subprocessing.general: General authorisation: the provider reports every intended change, and we can object
subprocessing.specific: Each sub-processor is authorised one by one

stated.label: From their questionnaire
stated.preselected: Preselected from their answers. Change it if your contract says otherwise.

dataProcessingAgreement.available: Offers a standard data processing agreement
dataProcessingAgreement.independentController: Says it is a controller in its own right
dataProcessingAgreement.noPersonalData: Says it processes no personal data for customers
dataProcessingAgreement.no: Processes customers' data, offers no data processing agreement

personalDataTransfers.inEea: Keeps customers' personal data in the EEA
personalDataTransfers.adequacy: Transfers outside the EEA on an adequacy decision
personalDataTransfers.sccs: Transfers outside the EEA on standard contractual clauses
personalDataTransfers.bcr: Transfers outside the EEA on binding corporate rules
personalDataTransfers.other: Transfers outside the EEA on another basis

subprocessorEngagement.general: Engages sub-processors under a general authorisation, with notice and a right to object
subprocessorEngagement.specific: Asks for a specific authorisation for each sub-processor
subprocessorEngagement.none: Engages no sub-processors for customers' personal data

stated.breachNotice: Notifies you of a personal data breach without undue delay
stated.noBreachNotice: Did not commit to notifying you of a personal data breach
